00047 LinPan2UGenInternal::LinPan2UGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& position, UGen const& level) throw()
00048 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, 1)
00049 {
00050   inputs[Input] = input;
00051   inputs[Position] = position;
00052   inputs[Level] = level;
00053 }
00054 
00055 void LinPan2UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00056 {
00057   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00058   float* outputSamples0 = proxies[0]->getSampleData();
00059   float* outputSamples1 = proxies[1]->getSampleData();
00060   float* positionSamples = inputs[Position].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00061   float* levelSamples = inputs[Level].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00062   
00063   ugen_assert(*positionSamples >= -1.f && *positionSamples <= 1.f);
00064   
00065   if(inputs[Input].getNumChannels() <= 1)
00066   {
00067     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00068 
00069     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00070     {
00071       float pos1 = *positionSamples++ * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00072       float pos0 = 1.f - pos1;
00073       float inputValue = *inputSamples++ * *levelSamples++;
00074       
00075       *outputSamples0++ = inputValue * pos0;
00076       *outputSamples1++ = inputValue * pos1;
00077     }
00078   }
00079   else
00080   {
00081     float* inputSamples0 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00082     float* inputSamples1 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 1);
00083     
00084     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00085     {
00086       float pos1 = *positionSamples++ * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00087       float pos0 = 1.f - pos1;
00088       float level = *levelSamples++;
00089       float inputValue0 = *inputSamples0++ * level;
00090       float inputValue1 = *inputSamples1++ * level;
00091       
00092       *outputSamples0++ = inputValue0 * pos0;
00093       *outputSamples1++ = inputValue1 * pos1;
00094     }   
00095   }
00096 }

00099 LinPan2::LinPan2(UGen const& input, UGen const& position, UGen const& level) throw()
00100 { 
00101   initInternal(2);
00102   
00103   UGen positionChecked = position.mix();
00104   UGen levelChecked = level.mix();  
00105   
00106   LinPan2UGenInternal*  internal = new LinPan2UGenInternal(input, positionChecked, levelChecked);
00107   internalUGens[0] = internal;
00108   internalUGens[1] = internal->getProxy(1);
00109   
00110   float pos1 = positionChecked.getValue(0) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00111   float pos0 = 1.f - pos1;
00112   
00113   if(input.getNumChannels() <= 1)
00114   {
00115     float inputValue = input.getValue(0) * levelChecked.getValue(0);
00116     internalUGens[0]->initValue(inputValue * pos0);
00117     internalUGens[1]->initValue(inputValue * pos1); 
00118   }
00119   else
00120   {
00121     float inputValue0 = input.getValue(0) * levelChecked.getValue(0);
00122     float inputValue1 = input.getValue(1) * levelChecked.getValue(0);
00123     internalUGens[0]->initValue(inputValue0 * pos0);
00124     internalUGens[1]->initValue(inputValue1 * pos1);  
00125   }
00126   
00127 }

00132 Pan2UGenInternal::Pan2UGenInternal(UGen const& input, 
00133                    UGen const& position, 
00134                    UGen const& level) throw()
00135 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, 1),
00136   panTable(Buffer::getTableConstantPan512()),
00137   lastPos(position.getValue(0) * 0.5f + 0.5f),
00138   last0(panTable.lookup(0, lastPos)),
00139   last1(panTable.lookup(1, lastPos))
00140 {
00141   inputs[Input] = input;
00142   inputs[Position] = position;
00143   inputs[Level] = level;  
00144 }
00145 
00146 void Pan2UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00147 {   
00148   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00149   float* outputSamples0 = proxies[0]->getSampleData();
00150   float* outputSamples1 = proxies[1]->getSampleData();
00151   float pos = *(inputs[Position].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0)) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00152   float* levelSamples = inputs[Level].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00153     
00154   if(pos == lastPos)
00155   {
00156     if(inputs[Input].getNumChannels() <= 1)
00157     {
00158       float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00159       
00160       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00161       {
00162         float inputValue = *inputSamples++ * *levelSamples++;
00163         
00164         *outputSamples0++ = inputValue * last0;
00165         *outputSamples1++ = inputValue * last1;
00166       }
00167     }
00168     else 
00169     {
00170       float* inputSamples0 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00171       float* inputSamples1 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 1);
00172       
00173       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00174       {
00175         float level = *levelSamples++;
00176         float inputValue0 = *inputSamples0++ * level;
00177         float inputValue1 = *inputSamples1++ * level;
00178         
00179         *outputSamples0++ = inputValue0 * last0;
00180         *outputSamples1++ = inputValue1 * last1;
00181       }
00182     }
00183 
00184   }
00185   else
00186   {
00187     float posInc = (pos - lastPos) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00188     
00189     if(inputs[Input].getNumChannels() <= 1)
00190     {
00191       float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00192 
00193       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00194       {
00195         lastPos += posInc;
00196         float inputValue = *inputSamples++ * *levelSamples++;
00197         
00198         last0 = panTable.lookup(0, lastPos);
00199         last1 = panTable.lookup(1, lastPos);
00200         
00201         *outputSamples0++ = inputValue * last0;
00202         *outputSamples1++ = inputValue * last1;
00203       }
00204     }
00205     else
00206     {
00207       float* inputSamples0 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00208       float* inputSamples1 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 1);
00209       
00210       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00211       {
00212         lastPos += posInc;
00213         float level = *levelSamples++;
00214         float inputValue0 = *inputSamples0++ * level;
00215         float inputValue1 = *inputSamples1++ * level;
00216         
00217         last0 = panTable.lookup(0, lastPos);
00218         last1 = panTable.lookup(1, lastPos);
00219         
00220         *outputSamples0++ = inputValue0 * last0;
00221         *outputSamples1++ = inputValue1 * last1;
00222       }
00223     }
00224     
00225     lastPos = pos;
00226   }
00227 }
